name: SVG Pan Zoom
description: Image-field formatter that renders SVG files with the svg-pan-zoom JS library for interactive pan and zoom.
project_description:
The Svg Pan Zoom module provides an integration of the Svg Pan Zoom library. It provides you a field formatter for your Image fields that supports SVGs.

 Svg Pan Zoom is a library that allows you to pan or zoom inside an SVG image.

 Requirements 

 
 Svg Pan Zoom Library - 3.6.1 release or higher 
 Svg Image 
 
 This module should work without jQuery.

 Upgrade 

You can upgrade from 8.x-1.0-x to 2.0.0, there is no significant change, but had to increase the version number to switch to semantic versioning.
